U.S. Energy Information Administration (2023). Updated Buildings Sector Appliance and Equipment Costs and Efficiencies, March 2023. Appendixes A-D: Guidehouse and Leidos, EIA - Technology Forecast Updates - Residential and Commercial Building Technologies (Reference and Advanced Cases), prepared for EIA.

Region: United States. Loaded only commercial equipment that matches the industrial space-conditioning archetypes, 2022 columns of the Appendix A Reference case: gas warm-air furnace (space-heater_fuel-fired), electric resistance heaters (small and large), rooftop and ground-source heat pumps (heat-pump_space, typical and high), water-cooled centrifugal chillers (typical to chiller_vapour-compression, high to chiller_high-efficiency), air-cooled screw chillers (chiller_vapour-compression) and direct-fired gas absorption chillers (chiller_absorption). Costs are total installed (2022 USD), converted from per kBtu/h or per ton to per kW (0.29307 kW per kBtu/h; 3.51685 kW per ton). Efficiencies: heating COP or full-load cooling COP as %, furnace thermal efficiency on the US HHV basis. In _other-values: high-bay lighting (metal halide, HPS, T5 HO, LED efficacy, life and cost per klm) and commercial boilers (space-heating hot-water scale, not mapped). Not loaded: residential equipment, water heaters, cooking, refrigeration, ventilation, rooftop air conditioners, projections to 2050 and the Advanced case (Appendixes B and D). Locator: page numbers printed in each appendix (Appendix A pages 109-145).
